# Fee proposal: civil and stormwater engineering

Dear Nadia,

Thank you for your request. We are pleased to offer our civil and stormwater engineering services
for the alterations and additions at 41 Tallowwood Avenue.

Background

We have reviewed the survey and the concept plans. The rear addition adds about 55 m² of new roof, drained to the existing system, plus the new paved terrace at the back of the house. The site falls
gently to the rear, and the existing roof water lines run along the side of the house to the kerb.

Roof water from the addition connects to the existing gravity system discharging to the kerb; OSD is not required.
There is no existing on-site detention on the lot. No stormwater quality treatment or MUSIC modelling
is required for a single dwelling addition. The site is outside the drinking water catchment, so no
NorBE assessment applies. No public road works are required.

Scope and fees

    Item  Description                                                  Fee (inc GST)
    ----  -----------------------------------------------------------  -------------
    1     Stormwater concept plan for the DA, showing the new roof        $2,420.00
          and terrace drained to the existing system
    2     Detailed stormwater design and erosion and sediment             $3,520.00
          control plan for the CC
    3     Works-as-executed review and stormwater certificate             $1,320.00
          for the occupation certificate
          ----------------------------------------------------------  -------------
          TOTAL                                                           $7,260.00

Total $7,260 including GST.

All amounts include GST.

Exclusions

- CCTV inspection of the retained drainage lines, if needed, at cost
- Works-as-executed survey (by the surveyor)
- Council application and inspection fees
- Geotechnical advice

Terms

Item 1 is invoiced on issue of the concept plan, item 2 on issue of the CC drawings, and item 3 on
issue of the certificate. Payment is due within 14 days. This offer is valid for 60 days.
